profile.text: Operator Lutonada, once active in war-torn regions across Bolívar. Unaffiliated with any local organization, she made a living cleaning up after battles. She now receives treatment on Rhodes Island and has signed a cooperative agreement with Logistics, where she will occasionally assist on field missions as a consultant on battlefield conditions.
